originality.rationale: The full motivating manuscript develops weighted reversible quantum search but does not give a necessary-and-sufficient all-transition-matrix entrance characterization. The known unweighted regular-complement cone theorem is a strict special case: a weighted four-vertex cone over a nonregular path admits perfect search, and unequal target-edge weights on a triangle can destroy it. Closest published adjacency-equitable and asymptotic spectral theorems do not imply exact probability-one attainment for arbitrary reversible P. value.rationale: Solves a natural exact-attainability classification in the weighted stationary-chain quantum-search model with arbitrary finite state space, self-loops and positive reversible edge weights. Gives unique tuning, all exact times, and equivalent stationary-conditional exit law. A four-vertex weighted cone over a nonregular path becomes perfectly searchable despite impossible unweighted dynamics; modifying target edge weights on a fixed triangle toggles attainability. This is a structural design rule, not an arbitrary small-graph computation.
